description: This file defines the Checkboxes class, a Drupal form element for rendering and processing a set of checkboxes, including methods for processing input, determining checked boxes, and handling default values.

classes.name: Checkboxes
classes.description: A Drupal form element class for a set of checkboxes, providing methods for processing, value handling, and checking checkbox states.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns metadata about the checkboxes form element, including processing and rendering callbacks.

methods.name: processCheckboxes
methods.description: Processes the checkboxes element, setting default values, attributes, and preparing each checkbox item.

methods.name: valueCallback
methods.description: Handles the form input for the checkboxes, normalizing checked and unchecked states.

methods.name: getCheckedCheckboxes
methods.description: Returns an array of keys for checkboxes that are checked based on submitted input.

methods.name: detectEmptyCheckboxes
methods.description: Checks if all checkboxes are unchecked.
